title: reveal_card
description: The sender reveals a card to every player, e.g. a card of their hand, or a card found in a deck they have looked at (Agasha Swordsmith: "reveal it"). The log gives the card to every player; nothing is recorded. A facedown province is turned face up with `reveal_province`, a facedown dynasty card with `reveal_dynasty_card`.

card_id.description: Card to reveal, of any player.
